DIAGNOSIS READY: Brucellosis (Zoonotic infection).

The combination of fever, headache, anorexia, fatigue, and malaise in a pregnant patient is highly suggestive of Brucellosis, a zoonotic disease often transmitted through unpasteurized dairy products or undercooked meat. Please confirm if you have consumed unpasteurized dairy or undercooked animal products, and I will request a serology test for confirmation.
